summary: You have 14 named doctors, WhatsApp and a payment plan, but conflicting hours and dates and a booking link to an Australian subdomain hurt trust.

findings.problem: The Book Now button points to au.patientdesk.ai, an Australian subdomain, and every doctor Read more link goes to the same /dubai-dentists page.
findings.cost: Patients sent to an odd address may not trust it or finish booking.
findings.fix: Booking on your own domain and a profile page per doctor.

findings.problem: Wednesday shows Closed in the hours table while the footer says Mon - Sat. The page says served JLT since 2023, since 2005-2023 and over 21 years.
findings.cost: Conflicting hours and dates make patients doubt the details.
findings.fix: One set of hours and one clear history.

findings.problem: Dr. Suhail Syed appears twice (Implantologist and Prosthodontist), the alt text says dr sushail syed, the Zirconia Crowns card ends mid sentence, and a line reads dental clinic in Dubai feature.
findings.cost: Errors on treatment pages weaken confidence in clinical care.

findings.problem: The page cites a 4.8 Google rating but shows no review text, shows no before and after cases, and lists Dental Offers in the menu with no offers on the page.
findings.cost: Patients want proof and a reason to act now.
findings.fix: A review wall, captioned results and a real offers section.

redesign: Booking on your own domain, a profile for each doctor and one set of hours.
A review wall, before and after gallery and a clear offers section.
